==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using VerifyTests.DiffPlex;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Verify.DiffPlex: when a text snapshot does not match, the failure message shows an inline
        // diff instead of the whole received and verified text.
        // OutputType.Compact prints only the changed lines, with a line of context either side.
        // Alternatives: OutputType.Full, OutputType.Minimal.
        VerifyDiffPlex.Initialize(OutputType.Compact);

        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/DiffPlexTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using VerifyTests.DiffPlex;

// Verify.DiffPlex: Shows an inline diff in the failure message of a text snapshot, instead of both files in full.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.DiffPlex
// Note: This changes only the failure message; what is written to a .verified. file is unaffected.
// Note: It is the default comparer for text. An extension that registers a comparer for a specific
// file extension, such as html or json, takes precedence for that extension.
public class DiffPlexTests
{
    // The module initializer sets the mode for every test. UseDiffPlex overrides it for one,
    // which is useful when a single snapshot is easier to read in full.
    [Fact]
    public Task PerTestOutput()
    {
        var target = "The text";
        return Verify(target)
            .UseDiffPlex(OutputType.Full);
    }
}
